_comment: WIMP-nucleon SI exclusion-limit reproduction, DAMIC 0.6 kg-day (PhysRevD.94.082006 / arXiv:1607.07410), Fig. 11 -- SINGLE-CHANNEL 1x1-only version (scope reduced from the earlier joint 1x1+1x100 attempt, see below). Halo/grid/rates_dir match the joint version. 1x1 channel: 11x11 window, sigma_pix=1.8e-, background 15x365.25=5478.75 events/(kg yr keV) (paper Sec. VIII). Pipeline: 1) python3 utils/wimp_nucleon_generate_grid.py configs/wimp_nucleon_generate_si_damic2016halo_izraelevitch.json (rate CSVs using the Izraelevitch-extended quenching table) 2) ./build/ccdarksens_scan_generic configs/examples/wimp_damic_snolab_2016.json 3) ./build/ccdarksens_plot_limit --batch --wimp <root> "..." --out-pdf <path>.pdf. WHY 1x1-only, not joint: the joint (response.channels[]) code path in RunJointChannelScan (apps/ccdarksens_scan_generic.cc) was found to not wire in the backgrounds.lee low-energy-excess term at all -- it builds each channel's background directly and never checks cfg.backgrounds().has_lee_bkg, unlike the single-channel path (BackgroundFactory.cc's MakeBackground(), which does). This was caught because the +LEE joint config produced BIT-IDENTICAL upper limits to the baseline joint config across all 28 mass points. Per explicit instruction, scope reduced to 1x1-only for now (which already correctly supports LEE via the working single-channel path) rather than patching the joint path immediately; a joint-channel LEE fix is a known follow-up, not done here. See wimp_damic_snolab_2016_lee.json for the +LEE sibling.
_header: Diego Venegas-Vargas | DAMIC-M collaboration | CCDarkSens Framework -- Student example: WIMP-nucleon SI, DAMIC at SNOLAB (2016) reproduction, single-channel (1x1 only) cluster-energy likelihood, LEE background off (baseline). Scope reduced from joint 1x1+1x100 after finding the joint path does not wire in the LEE background -- see _comment.
